content: Nuw Danieli Utaáchcheem Apanllpa mashirangi anoo kamanchintspa
Yuwash Medshuch tputs Daríyo suru, Asowerini wipa, Kaldewshucheem urkar kaneeschiri kinayaru,

minamari masach Utaáchchu anush, nuwsha Danieli, Jeremiyasarinee wirkar natstarangina. Yuwaa Apanll Jeremiyasaa kamanku: Tputs Irusarinaa kapeeteersin, izuuru sumasush mucheersin, 70 masach kurimunaz taachiya,
Apanll tárangu anoo natstarangina.
Ashiri anoo natstaranguri; Apanllee mashkuri, manguranguri, kamazee kucharee kamartayaruri, puzachush kuxineeruri, anush Apanllpat tsiyatarangina.

Yuwaam iy Utaáchchini Apanllee kasarangini anoom tsiyatkuri, tárangina: Apaa, shiyamari kasiru taaksha. Shiy kizpurtishcha. Shaanaatsee kukish uru iyaam tuminuksha. Tputs shiyaa chinaksin, kamachtamareetsish payuksin, shiysha uwaatssha chinakush uru istaksha.

Iy, Apaa, yutaritshishush izuuru pantsaranginiya. Nda shiyaa pakchiyam chinaranginiya. Izuuru shiyaa mapiyranginiya. Mishat, shiyaa kamachtamarish payumaam kasaranginiya. Shiyaa kukish mapiymari mapiyranginiya.

Mishat, kamanimapaneetstam kuk nda mazinaranginiya. Shiyaa kukish kamanimapan, kurakaa wipunasheetstam, mishat zitaminarineetstam ashparta kamanirangtaatssin, itaru iyashuchsha ichingarusin mapiyranganaya. Nda kukoo payuranganaya.

Apaa, shiy tsinastishcha. Itaru, iysha Utaáchchini shiyaa kukish izuuru kapeetarangani. Anumand kapung shiyaa pazikaniya. Irusarinshuchtam taakana, misha Israelchichtam shiyaa kukish kapeetarangtamsin, anumand shiysha minup tsap watsirit zanganirangish, minootssha tputs arap tsap zanganirangish, antamsin ichingarusin pazikanaya.
Apaa, iy zitaminarini, mishat zitaminarinitam urkar ashiruni yutaritam taakaniya. Ashirucha, iysha shiyaa paziktamaniya.
Itaru Apaa, shiy uru tputsee nayanikush, tputssha shiyaa mashku, yutaritshishee mbizamamari tachingangsha. Iy shiyaa kapung tayutaritaranginiya.
Shiyaa kukish mazinarangitaatini nda payuranginiya. Shiy tayaspatampanee iyaam zanganirangush, iyaa tayaspatarangitaatssin, itaru iysha anoo kuk nda payuranginiya.

Ichingarusin Israelchich shiyaa kukish kapeetarangsin, izuuru kamachtamareetsish ngataranganaya. Shiy tputsirish Móysisarini yandaku; Siy yutarit kapung taakchush anumand Apanll siyaa kapung wanichiya, tárangu, anuritam yuwamand ashirangani anumand na iyaamsha waneeshish tatsamoorangiya.

Waneeshee kapung zangankachush, izuuru shaanaatsi kukish tuminuchsha. Paptsa, Waneeshish naanllpa, tárangush, kurakawaatstam, mishat ichingaru tputsee wasina kamanirangtaatish, nda mazinarangana. Anumand waneeshish kizpur yutarit, sirútama nda tputs ashimaa waneeshish patarusin, an na Irusarinash pantsatarangiya.

Ichingaru yuwartatam Móysisarini, yandarangu anuritam iyash kusarangiya. Apaa, izuuru shiyaa kasaranguni, mangeetsini yarangandama, nda shiyaa táranginiya. Yutaritshisheetsimari izuuru payuranginiya. Nda shiyaa kukish payumaam chinaranginiya.

Ashirucha Apaa, shiy iyaam waneeshee wayarangush, izuuru waneerangsha. Watam shiy, Apaa, shaanaatsi kukish izuuru tuminukshawa. Shiy nllitarit chinatareezish. Iysha anoo yasarangitaatini, itaru shiyaa kukish kapung ngataranganiya.

Apaa, sirútamasa shaanaatsi tputsirish Ijiptosh tsap tashitungarangush, wizpureetsish kapung iyashcheem yámandarangsha. Ashirangush, tputs ztaru shiyaa mazinaranganaya. Na in zari shiyaa wandaritam nda mbizakanaya. Itaru, iysha Apaa, shiyaa kukish kapeetaranguni, yutarit kapung taaranganiya.

Apaa, iy shiyaa yasaktanicha. Shiy kizpurtishcha kchinamshish. Ashiri Apaa, Irusarinaa kizpur tsiyantayarush waneerangish an na tsiyanish zambazangi, watam shaana Irusarinaa mishat mach Siyonaa pangeemish ipusarangshawa. Itaru, iyamandari yutaritshishirini, mishat zitaminarinimandtam yutaritshishirini ichingarusin tputs iyaa tayutaritkanaya.

Ashiri Apaa, nuw shiyaa mashki anoo mazinangcha. Apaa, shiy pangish izuuru yurangarangu, ashiri shiysha anoo pangumaama istangcha. Chinasheetsish tuyamandangi, nda tputs shiyaa arangeem yutarit tsiyatamaama.

Ashiri Apaa, istanda. Nuwaa kuki mazinangcha. Kiyung kachiykiniya. Yaktarini Irusarin yurangarangiya, yuwash shiyaa ungirtatarini. Anoo napeerush istangcha. Yuwamun yutarit taakani anumuna shiyaa mashamaam pinasakaniya, watam iy yutarittaniwa. Itaru Apaa, shiyamun nayanimpanimunish mangi tatkuri mashkina.

Apaa, na mazinangandama. Iyaa Utaáchcheetsini yutaritshishirini tachingeerush istangcha. Tputs shiyaa yasapana, aturi, mashkina. Irusarinaa yusur yaramaam mashkitamana, mishat tputsirish shiyaa yusur chinapana aturi, mashkitamana. Ashiri, Apaa, iyaa istangcha. Zapshtarinllpa, Apanllee tsiyatkuri, tárangina. Na kamaneena yuwaa nuw Danieli Utaáchcheem Apanllpa mashirangi anootsi.
Ashiri na kamanchintspa yuwaatssha Apanll wasundurur 490 masachee wasina kamanirangu anootsi

Apanllee aranginasha masharangina. Apaa, Jeremiyas kuk na 70 mashach tatsameenlliya, táranguri, nuwaanaatsee yutaritshishiri yaramaam, mishat Israelchicheetstam yutaritshishirini yaramaam mashirangina. Apanlleemtam pang' mach Siyonaam mashirangitamana.

Ashiri Apanllpat tsiyatstar ashiranguri, zari pukamachsha, yuwash opeejaa Apanlleem pachamaam waritarangu, anush Apanll wasundurur Gabriel sur, yuw sirú nuwash miranish yakarangu, an mangakatanu kusarangiya.
Nuwaatssha tárangiya; Danielaa, shiyaa mangish izuuru p'tsimaam nuw ningeem kusarangina. Ashiri mazinangcha.

Shiy Apanllpa tsiyatamaam chtarangush, Apanllsha, Yuwaa ashtachi anoo Danielaa kamanishini, nuwaa tárangiya. Apanll shiyaa ksumish chinaku, nuwaa kamanimaam zanganirangiya. Ashiri Jeremiyasaa kuk kamankachuri, shiysha izuuru mazinangcha.

Siyaa Utaáchcheetsis yutaritshishiris izuuru tachingamaam 70 masach 7 tayusimaam wand pshatariya, misha Apanlleetstam yaktarini Irusarina izuuru yaramaama. Yutaritshishireetsis izuuru tachingamaam waritachu, Apanll min kurak tsinassha urutari tputsee ksutamaam wayachiya. Ashkachu, yuw tiptsiree wasina yámandarangu, mishat kamanirangu anoo tatsamchiya. Sheeru, Apanll waanaatsee pang' kizpur wanasirimshee wayachiya.

Neetstam mazinakchush mangoonangcha. Yuwamun tputs yaktaa Irusarin yusur pangungints, tákchu, anumunsha 7 masach 7 tayusiychu, Apanll tputsee kurakaam ipuskachu, waana tiptsiree ksutchiya. Yaktaa Irusarina yusursha panguchinllinaya. Ngootsee wanasirsha yareersin, yaktaa watandpun yusur tandapunuchinlliniya. Anamun 62 masach 7 tayusiychu, anush yaktash Irusarinash Utaáchich tputs taachinllina. Itaru, kapung kiyung kachiykusin taachinllinaya. Nda mapiyrsin taachinllinaya.

Aship masach tushiychu, anush Apanllee ipusamarini tputs pachachinllinaya. Ashkatssin, anamunsha minshuch kurak wasundururpat kuskatssin, yaktaa Irusarina, mishat Apanlleetstam pang' izuuru tunupeersin kasachinllinaya. Kung kizpur kumbiykchu, zaw ashtaru sheeru, izuuru ichingaroo kapeetchiya. Anumunsha tsapurunas ndatuma pastaru, uru tputs waanpatatin waratchinllinaya. Waratkatssin, tputs waanpatatin zapan pachakaktangat ashchinllinaya. Nda tputs pakchiyam mapiyrsin taachinllinaya, Apanll tárangiya.

Ashkusin, arangeem 7 masach tatsamoochu anush min kurak tputsee; Washunandsha wanasiri taayani, táchiya. Itaru, 3 masach anumun chawap natumasam mapiyrsin taachinllinaya. Itaru, anumunsha kuraksha Utaáchchee; Chineetsis Apanlleem muchintspa. Maacheetstam Apanlleem panarintspa, tákchu, izuuru Apanllee wamachtash kapeeteeru, anpanirisha taachiya. Apanllish pang' Apanllinung wasum mantsir tayutaritchiya.

Ashkachu, Apanllsha izuuru tpachingayaru kasachiya, Apanll muchchur Gabriel nuwaa Danielaatsi kamanku tárangiya. Na kamaneena yuwaa Apanll wasundurur 490 masachee wasina kamanirangu anootsi. [Ashiri wappari. Watamaricha nuw Danieli kuki.]

footnotes.text: Matiwa 24.15; Márkosa 13.14 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
